rules: Safety denominators are unique SAFFL=Y subjects.
Safety summaries use actual treatment TRT01A because this portfolio safety question is exposure-based.
Planned treatment TRT01P is retained only as a diagnostic counterfactual and must not silently replace actual treatment in safety denominators.
Subject incidence counts each subject at most once per endpoint; event counts may count multiple events.
Every ADAE-style treatment label must reconcile to the subject-level ADSL-style actual treatment.
The v0.23 efficacy rule is intentionally different: efficacy missing-data grouping follows planned randomised treatment.
interpretation_boundary: This is a public-data portfolio safety review, not a sponsor safety analysis convention for every protocol.
Risk differences are descriptive and are not a confirmatory safety hypothesis family.
The planned-versus-actual comparison is an audit showing why analysis purpose governs treatment assignment; it is not an alternative safety result for reporting.
